signals.title: USD/NOK — G10 Bilateral Theme + Geopolitical Tariff Escalation
signals.text: Trump signing the Russia sanctions bill opening China and India to secondary tariffs reinforces broad USD dominance, driving USD/NOK upward into the open. USD led G10 performance over the trailing week (+1.162%, n=9) while NOK lagged (-0.952%, n=2), establishing an extreme bilateral spread of 2.113% alongside a +135bp real policy rate differential favoring the dollar. The upcoming Norges Bank meeting on 24 Sep is the catalyst that determines whether monetary divergence can arrest the cross's upward trajectory. Trade bias: Bullish USD/NOK into the open; G10 divergence and tariff headline risk favor upside continuation. Catalyst: Norges Bank meeting on 24 Sep — hold vs hike decision. Risk: Brent crude rebound above $100/bbl or Norges Bank delivering a hawkish 25bp hike flips the cross lower.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Crowded Speculative Longs Face Unwind Risk
signals.text: AUD COT leveraged funds net long +59.3k (74.2% long, 97th percentile, z=+2.11) exposes AUD/USD to aggressive long-unwind risk following Friday's 0.7121 close. While the RBA holds an explicit hike bias with a +50bp OIS carry advantage (AONIA 4.35% vs SOFR 3.85%), extended positioning leaves the pair vulnerable to tariff-related risk-off contagion. The RBA meeting on 29 Sep is the catalyst that tests whether the hawkish stance can defend the 0.7100 handle. Trade bias: Bearish AUD/USD on rallies; extreme COT positioning caps further upside. Catalyst: RBA meeting on 29 Sep — hike bias pricing. Risk: RBA delivers a surprise 25bp rate hike or global risk sentiment rebounds sharply.
evidence: AUD COT LF net: +59,299 (74.2% long, 97th percentile, z=+2.11)

signals.title: EUR/USD — Crowded Net Short vs Bund-Treasury Spread Compression
signals.text: EUR COT leveraged funds net short -51.4k keeps EUR/USD pinned beneath technical resistance following Friday's 1.1489 close. European trade vulnerability to secondary US tariffs counteracts the ECB's rate level, while the -148bp 10Y Bund-Treasury spread maintains steady downside pressure toward 1.1400. The speech by Bundesbank President Nagel on Monday at 08:30 UTC is the catalyst that sets European rates expectations ahead of the ECB meeting on 29 Oct. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD; spot trading below 20/50/200 SMAs confirms structural weakness. Catalyst: Bundesbank President Nagel speech on Monday 08:30 UTC. Risk: Hawkish forward guidance from Nagel pushing 10Y Bund yields higher invalidates the short bias.
evidence: EUR COT LF net: -51,355 (38.4% long, 32nd percentile)
